groups.topic: Majority benefic/strong and adverse inverse plus small cattle

groups.topic: Traditionally malefic planet can still signify decent worker via essential dignity and aspect

clauses.historical_meaning: The apparently adverse planet is explicitly allowed to be essentially dignified, making a positive exception

groups.topic: Sixth ruler dignified angle or tenth house and servants advancement

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord sixt in any angle fortunate
clauses.historical_meaning: A fortunate sixth ruler in any angular house is assigned a positive source condition

groups.topic: Mercury positions, application, movable signs, many faithful servants

clauses.historical_meaning: Mercury's favorable state is a prerequisite before the author gives the many-servant prediction

The author alleges workers' honesty/loyalty without human evidence or ethical assessment validity

groups.topic: Mercury retrograde/combust and contact with malefics: period dishonesty allegations

clauses.historical_meaning: Mercury's retrograde motion is one alternative adverse condition in a broader combination

clauses.anchor_not_diplomatic: apply to Infortunes in fixed Signes
